Hourly spot and microstructure fields are complete, but retained bars are not market-wide buying confirmation; direct Binance spot-owner capture was disabled, and sentiment has no supplied directional reading. structural_calls: REGIME_RESILIENCE: Test whether the partial repair persists without treating the W44 decline as uninterrupted breakdown or the repair as durable expansion.
LEADERSHIP: Require persistent ETH/BTC improvement before calling renewed ETH leadership.
ROTATION_TRANSMISSION: Do not infer a full capitalization-ladder handoff from isolated participation.
BREADTH_PERSISTENCE: Require sustained short-window improvement alongside stronger longer-window participation before calling broad rotation.

FLOW_QUALITY_FRAGILITY: Weigh negative settled totals and weak breadth against positive retained-exchange taker imbalance and partial repair without treating spot bars as market-wide buying confirmation.
